units.hy: bp change, ICE BofA HY OAS
units.epu: change in 7-day avg log policy uncertainty x100

estimation: daily, 2022-01-03 to 2026-10-27 (1195 trading days), OLS with HAC(5) SEs; sector returns are daily log % returns of SPDR sector ETFs. File betas_2022_2025.csv holds these full-window betas (name kept for compatibility).
bonds: UST2/UST5/UST10: synthetic Treasury returns from FRED yields (10y = DFII10 + T10YIE, 2y = 10y - T10Y2Y, 5y interpolated), duration 1.9/4.6/8.5 with carry and convexity; TIPS10: DFII10, duration 8.7, real carry + breakeven accrual.
